summary: Introduces blocks as logical groups of tasks that also provide error handling similar to exceptions in programming languages.
questions: What are blocks used for in Ansible?
Is there something like try/catch in Ansible?

answer_card.title: What blocks are
answer_card.answer_md: Blocks group tasks logically, and also let you handle task errors in a way similar to exception handling (try/catch) in many programming languages, using `rescue` and `always` sections.
